comments: Features interlinear glosses consisting in references to the Supratiṣṭātantrasaṃgraha (D486) and Ānandagarbha’s treatises (D2521, D2523) (<<Kawasaki 2007 [X22QU3VM]>>).
name: rab tu gnas par byed pa don gsal (1)
item_description:
Script: 'bru tsha.
Orthography:
- Additional b- prefixes (e.g., brdzogs, bskyongs, bsreg, bston, dge bslong)
- Enclitic particles ’ang and ’o appear as separate syllables
- Alternative prefix: m- instead of ’a- (e.g., mthor for ’thor)
- las stsogs pa for la sogs pa
